title: PlaneMem current session state and activity reads
description: Source-only full output shapes for session state and run/tool-call directories and details. Current snapshots and recorded metadata are not original command receipts, tool execution results or proof a specific request succeeded.
$comment: Standalone schema; runtime additionally checks exact requested IDs/scope/trace, UTF-16/surrogate/real-date rules, descending order/unique IDs, filter/continuation relationships and identity equality. No validator/generator or SDK/Mock machine-contract integration. Closed outputs describe reconstructed server shapes, not every extra property tolerated on input by shared parsers.

scopeText.description: Current state scope is nonblank and exactly matches authorized request scope; this parser does not require a ULID.

identityText.$comment: Existing identity parser checks length<=1024 UTF-16 units, nonblank and no controls/DEL/lone surrogates. Leading/trailing whitespace preserved. All five identity fields use this rule, including scope; none independently require ULID.

identity.description: Current verified identity, supplied only for authenticated_client=true on state and single-record details. Not an authentication credential or original command identity proof.

permissions.description: Hint = authenticated_client AND (admin role OR session.write capability). Does not evaluate actual write Policy/OPA, actor ownership, state or expected versions. False when identity is absent; true requires identity.

source.description: Existing validateSourceRef checks nonempty strings and safe revision only. Extension fields survive shallow copy; no URI/type allowlist, count/length bound, deduplication or recursive visibility/freshness check.

sessionSource.description: Exactly the requested parent session, not a union of inner run/tool sources.

runListQuery.description: Decoded URL fields, parent session supplied by path. Default25 only when omitted. Wire accepts digits including leading zeros, then Number and bounded integer check. before_sequence is exclusive and need not identify an existing run.

toolListQuery.description: Decoded URL fields, parent session supplied by path. Optional run must exist in that session, even for an empty page. before_id is exclusive and need not identify a stored tool call. Limit accepts digits including leading zeros on HTTP.

session.description: Current parent at the same SQL statement snapshot as selected activity; version is not an inner run/tool version or original historical session_version.

ended_at.$comment: Runtime finite Date.parse and exact toISOString roundtrip, four-digit year only. No created/updated times in this output.

state.description: Current closure state; a terminal status is not proof that a particular original close request committed.

run.description: Current persisted run metadata. Null DB model is omitted; present model may be empty/unbounded string. Inner trace is saved record trace and need not equal current outer trace. No prompt/output/timestamps/usage or inferred parent-status compatibility.

tool.description: Recorded tool metadata, not execution/input/output verification. tool_name and saved trace only require nonempty strings; whitespace/length not further constrained by this parser. Parent session/run can be terminal while tool remains started.

runPage.description: Runtime checks exact requested session, strictly descending sequence below incoming bound, unique run IDs and <=limit. Continuation only on full page and equals last returned sequence. SQL limit+1; selected rows parsed, lookahead not parsed. Raw boundary binds no identity/filter/page size, has no signature or cross-page snapshot. No total or explicit limit/bound echo.

runDetail.description: One-statement current parent/run snapshot. Exact requested run and parent IDs checked; session.version and run.version independent.

toolPage.description: Echo run_id iff supplied; all selected records share requested session and optional run. Strict descending tool IDs below incoming bound (SQL COLLATE C). Continuation equals last ID on a full page. Server joins same-session run before selection, checks requested run exists in same SQL, parses only selected rows. Raw bound has no scope/identity/filter/limit binding or cross-page snapshot.

toolDetail.description: One statement reads current session, linked run and tool. Runtime checks requested tool ID, shared session IDs and run.run_id=tool_call.run_id. Existing tool with broken linked run is500, missing tool404. No cross-status consistency assertion.

stateEnvelope.description: Exact current outer trace/scope and sole session source. Identity, when present, matches scope. Shared parser used by server and SDK getSessionState rejects etag; SDK does not supply expectedIdentity, so actor/client are shape-checked but not pinned to SDK context. No outer revision or original request key.

runPageEnvelope.description: No outer scope/identity/permissions or ETag. Outer trace is current request; sources contain only requested session.

runDetailEnvelope.description: Current identity/permission hint outside data, no outer scope/ETag. Generic SDK parses data but does not independently check these hints, exact outer session source or outer trace equality.

toolPageEnvelope.description: No outer scope/identity/permissions/ETag; filter echo is data.run_id only when requested.

toolDetailEnvelope.description: Current identity/permission hint outside data, no outer scope/ETag. Generic SDK parses data but does not independently check these hints, exact outer session source or outer trace equality.
